Captured 2026-10-09 from https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/. Item/move filenames identify endpoints. Only relevant fields and en/zh-hant translations retained. tm01-live.json is the live machine endpoint response projection for every item/tm01 machine reference. These fixtures preserve upstream gaps (including missing BDSP TMs), not a guarantee of game availability.

The 2,372 machine-relations rows project item slug, version-group slug and move ID from https://github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi/tree/master/data/v2/csv (machines.csv, items.csv, version_groups.csv), retrieved 2026-10-09.
